title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-21
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard capture of the Aug‑21 1968 show with crystal‑clear Garcia tone and a legendary Dark Star→Eleven→Alligator run.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑fidelity soundboard tape that preserves Jerry’s crunchy, reverb‑splash guitar and Pigpen’s organ in vivid detail, despite occasional hiss and minor splicing quirks. Musically the concert is hailed as a peak‑‘68 performance – Dark Star, The Eleven, Alligator (with its post‑drums jam), Schoolgirl and the Cryptical→Other One sequence are repeatedly singled out as fireworks. Overall reviewers rave about the band’s tight interplay and the show’s irresistible flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the vast majority give 5‑star ratings and praise both the performance (standout Dark Star, Eleven, Alligator) and the soundboard quality; only minor recording hiss or editing notes appear, yielding a near‑perfect combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, tube‑warm guitar tone and clear organ; occasional tape hiss and some reviewers note odd track splits or short edits, but overall the mix is balanced and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe a seamless, high‑energy flow from the first set into a second‑set suite that builds intensity, with the Dark Star→Eleven transition and Alligator climax serving as the show’s centerpiece.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for an exceptional, crunchy tube tone, soaring solos, reverb‑rich jams (Mountain Jam theme) and strong vocals.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as “insane” and driving the psychedelic interplay, especially during Dark Star/Eleven sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (or early Tom C) credited for organ work on Schoolgirl and other jams; Pigpen’s organ praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming highlighted in the Alligator→Drums jam, described as tight and propulsive.
